objective: Bind current shared approval and story claims to every runtime evidence operation while preserving legacy reads

acceptance.text: Current-format pending, approved and revoked markers use tracked regular plans and exact Git digests; authorized current claims preserve the exact story contract, actor, route and branch without mutating foreign work.

Runtime start/check/gate/review/verify/finish require current shared approval and ownership; standalone Quick cannot bypass recognized shared projects, and changed plans, routes, claims or branches invalidate continuation.

Duplicate runs and claim/resume cannot reset spent retries or fixes, unavailable explicit builder routes fail without fallback, current state is default for new projects, and legacy reads and original compatibility regressions remain supported.
